runs.sql: SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM atoms a, atoms b WHERE a.id = 'p5.L103' AND b.id = 'p5.L87'
